name: Poly FM (Editable)
description: This algorithm is a version of the Poly FM algorithm which forgoes multi-timbrality in favour of being able to edit the actual FM voice parameters, just as if you were editing a real DX7. Banks are loaded from the MicroSD card. Unlike the Poly FM algorithm, this version has a 'Confirm' step before changing to a new voice. This is because you're actually 'loading' it, potentially replacing your edits, rather than simply choosing a (read only) voice to play. Any changes you make can be saved back to the bank on the MicroSD card. This algorithm supports a subset of Yamaha's System Exclusive protocol for editing the DX7, enabling you to use the algorithm with editor/librarian apps on your computer (for example, Dexed).
